# DATA_SPEC — synthetic data only (generated by src/tracefx/simulate.py)

**Source:** generated locally, deterministic, no download, no external API. Nothing else is needed.
**Optional stretch (UNVERIFIED availability):** an independent-generator sanity run (e.g. IBM AML-style data). Not required; never block on it.

## Files and sizes
| Name | Seed | Accounts | Days | ~Rows | ~CSV size | Purpose | In git? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| demo_small | 42 | 600 | 30 | 5,000 | 0.7 MB | live demo, judge's pen, UI dev | yes |
| seedA | 42 | 2,000 | 60 | 45,000 | 6-7 MB | tune weights | no (`make data`) |
| seedB | 7 | 2,000 | 60 | 45,000 | 6-7 MB | unseen validation | no |
| seedC | 2026 | 2,000 | 60 | 45,000 | 6-7 MB | unseen + undetectable ring type | no |
Row counts within +/-10%. Start time: 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z. Rows sorted by `ts`. `make data` must finish in <60 s.

## CSV schema (input file; NO label column)
`tx_id` str (T0000001...) · `ts` ISO-8601 UTC · `payer_id` str (A + 5 random non-contiguous digits) · `payee_id` str (account A..., merchant M..., wallet W...) · `amount` float 2dp INR · `tx_type` {MERCHANT, P2P} · `channel` {UPI, CARD, NETBANKING, WALLET} · `device_id` str · `ip` str · `merchant_id` str|null (= payee_id when MERCHANT) · `item_id` str|null (MERCHANT only) · `city` str · `account_open_date` date (payer's).
Required for the engine: tx_id, ts, payer_id, payee_id, amount. `tx_type` optional (absent => treat all as potential transfers).

## Normal population (same generator for everyone, ring accounts included)
- Tenure at window start: 70% >365 d, 20% 90-365 d, 10% <90 d.
- Activity: Poisson, ~11 tx/account/month (demo ~8). 70% MERCHANT, 30% P2P.
- Amounts: per-account lognormal, mu~N(ln 800, 0.6), sigma~0.5, clipped 10-50,000; non-round: <10% of amounts multiples of 100.
- Each account: 5-15 repeat payees (40% accounts, 60% merchants), 1-2 devices, 1 home IP (20% of tx on a mobile IP), home city (95% of tx).
- Items: catalogue 300 (demo 150), Zipf s=1.1; each account prefers 3-6 items. Merchants: 120 (demo 60).
- Legit wallets: 30 (landlords, shopkeepers) as P2P payees.
- IDs non-contiguous; accounts shuffled so ring members are not adjacent.

## Fraud scenarios (ground truth lives in truth_<seed>.json only)
| ID | Where | What | Expected result |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 (x3 in eval seeds: 10, 7, 5 accounts; x1 in demo: 10) | all | 14 days of normal warm-up; then within 48 h: 70-90% of members share one device; 4-item rare-item sequence (bottom-decile items), each member does 2-4 of the 4 in order, 30% chance of an inserted noise item; each member receives 20k-60k from an external wallet, then 70% send 80-95% to one sink wallet within 5-30 min, 30% within 30-90 min | FRAUD (M1+M2+M4, usually M3) |
| R2 (x2 in eval; x1 in demo: 4 accounts) | all | mule chain A->B->C->D->sink wallet, hop gap 5-25 min, 85% pass-through, no shared device, no sequence | REVIEW (single structural type) or partial; this is intended |
| R3 (x2) | seedC only | cyclic ring: 4 accounts circulate 30k around a loop 3 times in 6 h; no shared device/sink | not FRAUD; REVIEW or miss; reported honestly |
Ring members are sampled from the same tenure/amount/device distributions as everyone (no tells). Evasion variants via `generate(..., evasion=0|1|2)`: 1 = no shared device, timing jitter x3; 2 = level 1 + sink split across 3 wallets + 50% of sequence positions randomised.

## Hard negatives (must exist in every seed; counts eval / demo)
| Kind | Count | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Family device groups (2-4 aged accounts, shared device+IP, prior payer/payee links) | 6 / 2 | LEGIT or REVIEW, never FRAUD; one group has one large transfer (REVIEW demo case C) |
| Hostel/office IP shared by 30 / 15 accounts | 1 | no evidence (hub cap) |
| Flash-sale cohort: 200 / 60 aged accounts, same 3-item sequence within 10 min, no money convergence | 1 | no alert (convergence rule) |
| Landlord wallet: 12 / 6 payers, monthly on day 1 | 1 | LEGIT |
| Salary-day burst: 40% of accounts do bills within 2 h on days 1 and 31 (demo: day 1) | 2 / 1 | no alert |
| Traveller: new device+city for 3 days, normal amounts | 3 / 1 | REVIEW or LEGIT, never FRAUD (demo case D) |
| High-value legit: 80k-400k from accounts with tenure >730 d to repeat payee/merchant | 15 / 4 | LEGIT with why-not panel (demo case B) |

Fraud prevalence: ~0.3-0.4% of rows in eval seeds (labelled as such), ~2% in demo_small (label it "demo concentration").

## Generator tests (must pass)
Deterministic hash for same seed · rows sorted, tx_id unique · no `label` column · round-amount share <10% · ring tenure/amount means within 2 sd of population · warm-up tx per ring account >=8 (demo >=5) · every hard-negative kind present with listed counts · truth ids all exist in CSV · evasion levels change ring structure as specified.

## Git policy
Commit `data/demo_small.csv` + `data/truth_demo_small.json`. Seeds are generated by `make data`, listed in `.gitignore`.
